import openpyxl

# 讀取工作簿
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(INPUT_PATH)
ws = wb["用料明細"]

# 定位第二列標頭（包含「功能」的那一列），並以其上一列為第一列標頭
header_row2 = None
for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        if str(ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value or "").strip() == "功能":
            header_row2 = row
            break
    if header_row2:
        break

if header_row2 is None:
    raise ValueError("找不到「功能」欄位")

header_row1 = header_row2 - 1
data_start_row = header_row2 + 1

# 建立有效欄名對照：若第二列標頭有值則用第二列，否則用第一列
col_name_to_idx = {}
for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
    name2 = str(ws.cell(row=header_row2, column=col).value or "").strip()
    name1 = str(ws.cell(row=header_row1, column=col).value or "").strip()
    effective_name = name2 if name2 else name1
    if effective_name:
        col_name_to_idx[effective_name] = col

required_cols = ["項次", "料號", "品名", "功能"]
for c in required_cols:
    if c not in col_name_to_idx:
        raise ValueError(f"找不到欄位：{c}")

# 建立或覆蓋新工作表
new_sheet_name = "功能不合格"
if new_sheet_name in wb.sheetnames:
    wb.remove(wb[new_sheet_name])
new_ws = wb.create_sheet(title=new_sheet_name)

# 寫入標題
new_ws.append(required_cols)

# 篩選「功能」不是「OK」的資料列
for row in range(data_start_row, ws.max_row + 1):
    func_val = str(ws.cell(row=row, column=col_name_to_idx["功能"]).value or "").strip()
    if func_val != "OK":
        new_ws.append([
            ws.cell(row=row, column=col_name_to_idx["項次"]).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=col_name_to_idx["料號"]).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=col_name_to_idx["品名"]).value,
            ws.cell(row=row, column=col_name_to_idx["功能"]).value,
        ])

# 儲存結果
wb.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
